description.value: Little Creek Grill is a family-owned restaurant in Princeton with roots going back to 1982, when the Goreas family opened it under the name Santos. Rebranded in 2014 after the founding family returned to Princeton, it serves a broad menu of Greek-inflected dishes alongside pizza, pasta, steaks, and seafood. The kitchen makes desserts in-house and offers full catering services across the Similkameen Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at littlecreekgrill.ca is active and fully corroborates OSM contact data: phone (250) 295-6644 and address 117 Bridge St Princeton, BC V0X 1W0 both match. The menu pages confirm takeout availability via an explicit 'TAKE OUT ONLY - 2 FOR 1' pizza promotion, and confirm vegetarian and gluten-free options (Vegetarian Penne, GF Stuffed Manicotti, GF pizza crust, multiple GF desserts). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, family-owned restaurant in Princeton with a functioning website, confirmed address and phone, and a full menu — straightforward include for the directory.
